summary: Virax Biolabs Group Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to update its at-the-market (ATM) offering capacity under its existing F-3 shelf registration. The supplement declares the company may sell up to $2,070,060.20 of ordinary shares through H.C. Wainwright, reflecting public float limits under General Instruction I.B.5. Approximately $3.66 million had already been sold under prior supplements, and $737,000 in the last 12 months. The filing is a routine regulatory update for an ongoing ATM program, not a definitive special-situation transaction. No structural terms, premiums, or board actions are present. The offering is incremental and subject to market conditions under the existing sales agreement.
